text: To create a savory dish, begin by adding onions and garlic to the cooking area. Onions provide the base flavor known as the "mirepoix," essential in French cuisine. To start, chop the onions and garlic finely and sauté them in oil until they become translucent and slightly caramelized. This process, referred to as "sweating," enhances the natural sweetness of the onions and adds complexity to the meal. Garlic, combined with the onions, complements the onions' flavor and adds a pungent, aromatic element to the dish, elevating the overall taste of the meal.
